author: Crimson_Aught
body:
I know, warning is nothing, but I haven't said anything like that. It is a matter of principle.
Guy asked (i killed him before) "Is hacking allowed on this server"
I answerd "Yes you can, but for that server will give you a ticket in Permbanlandia" 

Is humor not allowed on Avicus now? If so, why did no one warn me before?
